ALL IN CAPITAL | INBOUND APPLICATION
Application Form Response
Submitted through the fund's public application form. Responses are reproduced as the applicant wrote them.
Company
Company name GrainKind (GrainKind Foods Pvt. Ltd.)
Website www.grainkind.example
Location Bengaluru, Karnataka
Incorporated July 2025
One-line description Millet-based breakfast and snacks for urban families.
Sector (as selected) Consumer brands
Stage (as selected) Pre-seed
Team size 9
Founders
Founder 1 Ritu Hegde, CEO. 6 years in category and brand roles at a large
packaged-food company. Food science degree. linkedin.com/in/ritu-
hegde-example
Founder 2 Sanjay Kulkarni, COO. 5 years in supply chain at a quick-commerce
company. linkedin.com/in/sanjay-kulkarni-example
Time commitment Both full-time since July 2025.
Prior startup experience None. First-time founders.
Equity split Founders 82%, angels 18%.
Product and traction
What have you built? Seven millet-based products. Three hero SKUs account for 87% of
orders. All made by one co-packer in Hosur.
Revenue INR 16.5 L in October 2026. INR 72 L since launch in November 2025.
Channel mix Own site 55%, Amazon 25%, quick commerce 20%.
Repeat behaviour 90-day repeat rate was 31% (June cohort), 34% (July) and 38% (August).
Cohort data covers 3,100 customers.
Unit economics Gross margin 48% after COGS and packaging. Blended CAC INR 340.
Contribution after CAC and logistics is 11%. 12-month LTV to CAC is
about 1.8x on current data.
Customer acquisition Paid social 45% of new customers (CAC INR 410), quick commerce 25%
(INR 290 after promos), nutritionist referrals 20% (INR 210), gyms and
sampling 10% (INR 380).

Key risks Single co-packer, rising paid social costs, and slower repeat on Jowar
puffs.
Fundraising
Amount raising INR 2.5 Cr
Valuation expectation INR 14 Cr post-money
Existing investors Three angels from the food and retail industry, INR 45 L in total.
Use of funds Inventory and working capital, growth channel tests, team and R&D.
Other investors in
conversation
One consumer fund.
How did you hear about us? Public application form.
Anything else we should know?
We can share our cohort sheet and co-packer agreement on request.
